provenance.drafted_basis: The April text cites the Tesla Q1 2026 earnings call transcript of April 22, 2026.
provenance.drafting_evidence_detail: No commit, no server-side revision record, and no reliable local timestamp establishes when the April text was written. The parent forecast SEER-2026-0003 locked 2026-03-23, which is eight days before Q1 2026 closed and a month before the earnings call the text cites; that lock is evidence about the parent, not about this addendum.
provenance.post_hoc_scope: Tesla reported Q2 2026 in July 2026, before this registration. The Q1 and Q2 portions of this addendum, including the counterfactual and the interpretation table's first row, are registered POST-HOC and carry no pre-registration credit. Only the Q3 decision rule below is locked ahead of its data.

recorded_resolution.criterion: Automotive gross margin (excluding regulatory credits) stays below 18%, confirming margin compression trajectory and R→F cascade propagation
recorded_resolution.observed: Q1 2026 automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits reported at 19.2%, above the 18.0% threshold. The locked criterion resolves FALSE on its first checkpoint.
recorded_resolution.scoring_conflict_unresolved: SCORING_POLICY.md v1.0 defines Brier once per forecast, using the primary scenario probability against the weighted forecast score. The published Tesla forecast card instead describes a per-prediction Brier ('a prediction at 85% that resolves correctly scores 0.0225'). These two published documents specify different schemes. Both figures are recorded here. This addendum does not choose between them; the reconciliation is a scoring-policy decision, not a scoring result.

q3_precommitment.criterion: Automotive gross margin (excluding regulatory credits) stays below 18%, confirming margin compression trajectory and R→F cascade propagation

observed_to_date.source: Tesla quarterly updates and 10-Q filings, automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits, as reported.

decision_rule.statement: The mechanism verdict on R->F cascade propagation is decided by the equal-weighted mean of Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits, as Tesla reports them.
decision_rule.if_q3_below_threshold: Three-quarter mean falls below 18.0%. The R->F cascade propagation claim survives this test. Survival means this falsifier did not fire conceptually. It does not mean the claim is correct.
decision_rule.if_q3_at_or_above_threshold: Three-quarter mean reaches or exceeds 18.0%. The R->F cascade propagation claim is substantially wrong and requires revision or replacement.
decision_rule.no_exclusions: No quarter is excluded for one-time items. Reported figures only.
decision_rule.symmetry_commitment: No downward adjustment will be applied to a Q3 print above the threshold, and no upward adjustment to one below it. Adjusted-margin analysis may be published alongside but does not enter this rule.
